stories.title: Social media limits are coming for teens across Europe
stories.author: Robert Hart
bullet_points: The EU is considering major new regulations targeting teenagers' use of social media.
Potential restrictions include implementing age limits, outright bans, or phased access to platforms.
Social media companies may be required to prove their services are safe for minors before deployment.

stories.title: Grok CLI uploaded the whole home directory to GCS
stories.author: denysvitali
bullet_points: A security vulnerability was discovered in the Grok CLI tool.
The vulnerability allowed the tool to upload an entire user's home directory to Google Cloud Storage (GCS).
This represents a critical data exposure risk associated with the software.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights a trending model, DeepSeek-R1, on the Hugging Face platform.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under key AI/ML topics such as 'transformers' and 'text-generation'.
The presence of 'safetensors' indicates modern, efficient model handling practices.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the core NLP/LLM domain, specifically text generation.
The tags indicate relevance to transformers and safetensors, key ML technologies.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: DeepSeek-V4-Pro is trending on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and 8VC.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.31 achieves significant speed improvements for Gemma 4 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Speedup reaches up to 90% when running coding agents, as validated by the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released as an open-source framework for building personal AI agents.
The key feature is that these agents can run entirely on the user's local hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, facilitating local LLM execution.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance optimization.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon hardware, leveraging Apple's native ML framework.
The feature is currently available in a preview state, signaling an optimization push for local AI on Apple devices.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed to integrate with messaging applications.
It utilizes local AI coding agents, ensuring all processing runs directly on the user's device.
The core value proposition is providing private, on-device AI assistance for coding tasks.

stories.title: Quantum error correction can constantly recalibrate a processor
stories.author: John Timmer
bullet_points: Quantum error correction is being advanced by using reinforcement learning.
The core mechanism involves using error information to dynamically adjust processor control algorithms.
This represents a significant step toward making quantum processors more stable and reliable.

stories.title: Ransomware negotiator hired to represent victims was working for the attackers
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: A ransomware negotiator was found to be working for the attackers they were hired to represent.
The individual was sentenced to six years in prison for betraying the victims.
The story highlights severe ethical breaches within the cybersecurity incident response industry.

stories.title: Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence
stories.author: Kai Chen
bullet_points: Current large language model pretraining heavily relies on text, overlooking crucial visual information.
The research addresses the limitation of discarding visual cues (like figures, equations, and layouts) by converting documents to plain text.
The paper proposes a new method for scalable visual pretraining to enhance language intelligence by incorporating visual data.

stories.title: Evolution of Accuracy and Visual-Cognitive Errors in a Decade of Vision-Language AI Models
stories.author: Miguel P. Eckstein
bullet_points: The research addresses a limitation in current Vision-Language Model (VLM) evaluations, which often rely on simple scenes (e.g., MS-COCO).
A new benchmark, the Complex Social Behavior (CSB) dataset, has been introduced to test VLMs on complex human interactions.
The study focuses on analyzing the types of visual-cognitive errors made by VLMs, moving beyond simple accuracy metrics.

stories.title: LLM for EDA in Front-End Design: Challenges and Opportunities
stories.author: Ulf Schlichtmann
bullet_points: LLMs are being explored as a solution to address bottlenecks in complex, time-sensitive front-end chip design.
The potential application of LLMs extends beyond simple specification understanding to include HDL generation and testbench construction.
The integration of agentic AI is highlighted as a key area for future development in Electronic Design Automation (EDA).

stories.title: A Sovereign, Open-Source Foundation Model for German and English
stories.author: Max Lübbering
bullet_points: Introduction of Soofi S 30B-A3B, a sovereign, open-source MoE hybrid Mamba Transformer foundation model.
The model achieves high throughput for long-context deployment by activating only 3B of its 30B parameters per token.
It is specifically designed for German and English, pretrained on 27 trillion tokens with an emphasis on German language data.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release enhances performance and model compatibility.
Integration of GGUF model support via llama.cpp broadens model accessibility.
The update improves MLX engine functionality, especially on Apple silicon hardware.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing the Nemotron 3 Ultra model.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for subagents within Claude Code.
The update also enables web search functionality within the Claude Code environment.
This suggests an enhancement in the capability of local LLM orchestration tools for complex, real-time tasks.

stories.title: Waze is getting a bunch of new AI-powered features
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: Waze is integrating Google's Gemini AI assistant into the driving application.
The updates aim to allow users to personalize their driving trips more effectively.
Two of the four new features specifically involve the integration of Gemini.

stories.title: Apple’s failed self-driving car program left a legacy of powerful AI chips
stories.author: Terrence O’Brien
bullet_points: Apple's abandoned self-driving car project is theorized to be a key driver behind the development of its powerful on-device AI chips.
The program necessitated early and intensive research into high-performance, localized AI processing capabilities.
Despite the car platform not reaching completion, the underlying AI hardware advancements have become a significant legacy for Apple's current chip architecture.

stories.title: China recovered its first reusable rocket and showed a new way to do it
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: China has successfully recovered its first reusable rocket.
The recovery method suggests an effort to replicate technologies pioneered by SpaceX.
The development signals a significant advancement in China's space technology capabilities.

stories.title: PHINN-EEG: Topological Time-Series Analysis of Dream-State EEG -- Dynamic Betti Curves for Dream Content Classification and Topology-Conditioned Neural Signal Synthesis
stories.author: Jayabrata Bhaduri
bullet_points: Introduces PHINN-EEG, a novel topological time-series framework for analyzing EEG data during dream states.
Moves beyond traditional PSD and statistical features used in current dream detection methods.
Utilizes Persistent Homology (PH) concepts to classify dream content and condition neural signal synthesis.

stories.title: VEXAIoT: Autonomous IoT Vulnerability EXploitation using AI Agents
stories.author: Maanak Gupta
bullet_points: Introduces VEXAIoT, an autonomous multi-agent framework designed for IoT vulnerability exploitation.
Addresses the inherent security risks in IoT systems (constrained hardware, outdated firmware).
Applies AI agent technology, specifically LLM agents, to the under-explored domain of IoT security testing.

stories.title: ConceptSMILE: Auditing the Trustworthiness of Concept-Based Explainable AI
stories.author: Zhibao Mian
bullet_points: Introduces ConceptSMILE, a new model-agnostic framework for auditing the trustworthiness of concept-based Explainable AI (XAI).
Addresses the limitation that concept-level explanations, while human-understandable, are not inherently trustworthy.
Extends perturbation-based auditing logic (similar to SMILE) from feature/region attribution to concept explanations.

stories.title: Semantic Pareto-DQN: A Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Framework for Financial Anomaly Detection
stories.author: Lucca Machado da Silva
bullet_points: Proposes Semantic Pareto-DQN, a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework.
Addresses the 'fraud collapse' issue in financial anomaly detection caused by class imbalance.
Synthesizes heterogeneous transaction features into natural-language narratives for better feature encoding.

stories.title: 4DR360: State Reasoning for Joint 3D Detection and Occupancy Prediction in 4D Radar-Camera Full-Scene Perception
stories.author: Hui-liang Shen
bullet_points: Introduces 4DR360, a new method for joint 3D detection and occupancy prediction using radar-camera fusion.
Addresses the limitation of sparse radar returns by integrating radar data with camera information for full-scene perception.
Overcomes shortcomings in existing methods by enabling deeper interaction between detection and occupancy tasks.

stories.title: Agora: Enhancing LLM Agent Reasoning Via Auction-Based Task Allocation
stories.author: Yue Feng
bullet_points: Proposes 'Agora,' a new framework to improve LLM agent reasoning and orchestration.
Addresses limitations in existing systems by moving beyond coarse-grained task matching.
Introduces an auction-based mechanism to account for performance variability and cost efficiency among expert models.

stories.title: PHINN-EEG: Topological Time-Series Analysis of Dream-State EEG -- Dynamic Betti Curves for Dream Content Classification and Topology-Conditioned Neural Signal Synthesis
stories.author: Jayabrata Bhaduri
bullet_points: Introduces PHINN-EEG, a novel topological time-series framework for analyzing EEG data during dream states.
Moves beyond traditional methods (like PSD) by employing Persistent Homology for dream content classification.
Aims to improve upon existing state-of-the-art dream detection AUC of ~0.70 using advanced neural signal synthesis.

stories.title: Semantic Pareto-DQN: A Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Framework for Financial Anomaly Detection
stories.author: Lucca Machado da Silva
bullet_points: Proposes Semantic Pareto-DQN, a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework.
Addresses the 'fraud collapse' issue in financial anomaly detection caused by class imbalance.
Synthesizes heterogeneous transaction features into natural-language narratives for better modeling.

stories.title: Entropy-Constrained Machine Learning with Residual Data Augmentation for Modeling Chemical Kinetics
stories.author: Opeoluwa Owoyele
bullet_points: Introduces a physics-constrained ML framework to accelerate Direct Numerical Simulation (DNS) of turbulent reacting flows.
Uses a surrogate model to predict chemical reaction rates from reduced thermochemical states, replacing complex source term evaluations.
Incorporates the second law of thermodynamics as a training constraint (non-negative entropy generation) to ensure physical consistency.

stories.title: Beyond Fixed Representations: The Vocabulary and Verifier Gaps in Open-Ended AI
stories.author: Haiqian Yang
bullet_points: Modern AI systems are limited by fixed representational frames, including their conceptual vocabulary and solution search space.
The paper addresses the 'Vocabulary and Verifier Gaps' in current open-ended AI capabilities.
The research suggests a need to move beyond pre-supplied, fixed frameworks to build more robust AI.

stories.title: The Count Is There, but Misaligned: Understanding and Correcting Counting Failures in VLMs
stories.author: Kentaro Inui
bullet_points: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit surprising failures in basic object counting despite overall strong multimodal performance.
Research suggests VLMs may internally encode the correct count even when their verbalized output is wrong.
Nonlinear probes applied to VLM activations can reliably detect these counting errors, pointing to a representation-to-output gap.

stories.title: CoCoT-EEG: Contrastive-Pretrained Multiscale Convolutional Transformer for EEG Decoding
stories.author: Richard Gao
bullet_points: Introduces CoCoT-EEG, a new model architecture combining contrastive learning and multiscale convolutional transformers for EEG decoding.
Addresses limitations of existing EEG pretraining methods (like raw EEG tokenization and masked reconstruction) due to high noise and limited frequency band information.
Leverages self-supervised foundation models for non-invasive EEG decoding, indicating progress in applying large-scale ML to biomedical signals.

stories.title: Agora: Enhancing LLM Agent Reasoning Via Auction-Based Task Allocation
stories.author: Yue Feng
bullet_points: Proposes 'Agora,' a new framework to improve LLM agent reasoning by optimizing task allocation.
Addresses limitations in current systems that use coarse-grained matching, ignoring performance variability and cost.
Introduces an incentive-compatible mechanism to manage the orchestration of diverse expert models and tools.

stories.title: Tokenizer Transplantation: Mitigating Autoregressive Collapse in Edge-Efficient Bengali ASR
stories.author: Md. Abdur Rahman
bullet_points: Addresses a critical challenge in deploying lightweight Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models on edge devices for non-Latin languages like Bengali.
Identifies the root cause of performance failure in optimized models (e.g., Moonshine) as the use of an English-centric byte-level tokenizer.
Proposes a novel 'vocabulary transplantation pipeline' to mitigate autoregressive collapse caused by token fragmentation in morphologically rich languages.

stories.title: FreyaTTS Technical Report
stories.author: Mustafa Yavuz
bullet_points: Introduction of Freya-TTS, a new compact, tokenizer-free text-to-speech model.
The model utilizes a 183.2M-parameter non-autoregressive Conditional Flow-Matching Diffusion Transformer (DiT).
It is specifically designed for highly reliable and efficient conversational synthesis, with a focus on Turkish language support.

stories.title: Neural Collapse Is Forbidden: Information Floors in Language Models
stories.author: Bruno Abrahao
bullet_points: The paper challenges the concept of 'incomplete neural collapse' in language models, reinterpreting within-class variance as allocated information storage.
Analysis of 14 models shows that macro-category structure accounts for only 4-12% of representational variance.
The majority of representational variance (79-91%) is attributed to within-token context, a finding stable across large parameter counts.

stories.title: GhostLock, a stack-UAF that has existed in all Linux distributions for 15 years
stories.author: ranger_danger
bullet_points: GhostLock is a stack-UAF vulnerability that has persisted across all Linux distributions for an extended period (15 years).
The vulnerability type is Use After Free (UAF), a critical memory safety issue.
The discovery highlights long-standing, deeply embedded security flaws within core Linux components.

stories.title: Five ways your LLM cost tracking is lying to you
stories.author: yutomakihara
bullet_points: The article addresses common inaccuracies in current LLM cost tracking methodologies.
It details five specific metering bugs encountered during LLM cost tracking implementation.
The content provides practical fixes for issues like streaming usage and cache token semantics.

stories.title: Your agent's memory remembers what you chose. Does it remember what you rejected?
stories.author: a_e9d710dc0b575ff2fb87a3a
bullet_points: Introduces VetoBench, a new metric designed to test AI agent memory beyond simple recall.
VetoBench specifically evaluates if agents re-propose previously rejected or ruled-out approaches.
Compares the performance of two models, RoBrain and Mem0, on this novel memory testing scenario.

stories.title: Stop Letting AI Write Your Entire Component
stories.author: ntty
bullet_points: Addresses the risk of over-reliance on AI coding assistants (like Cursor).
Focuses on maintaining developer skills in debugging and code maintenance.
Offers guidance on integrating AI tools without sacrificing core engineering abilities.
